constraints.constraint: Show the penguins from a different camera angle than the reference.
constraints.A_evidence: The close, low viewpoint on penguins differs from the reference's wider view of birds with chicks.
constraints.B_evidence: The closer view among the penguins also differs from the reference's wider viewpoint.

constraints.constraint: Target an image with a cloudy background.
constraints.A_evidence: Prominent cloudy sky fills much of the background behind the penguins.
constraints.B_evidence: The background is mostly water and shoreline; no cloudy sky is visible.

constraints.constraint: Keep the camera focus on the penguins.
constraints.A_evidence: The foreground penguins are the clear focal subjects.
constraints.B_evidence: The penguins are also the clear focal subjects.

judgment.reason: Both candidates show penguins from a changed viewpoint, but A distinctly fulfills the requested cloudy background, while B has water and shoreline behind the birds.
